purpose: Teach: 東南アジア/四国/採取/タンパク質/探査/単身/誤差/交易

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、東南アジア、絶対、の経済、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on Southeast Asian economics was really impressive. The depth of your research genuinely impressed me.
lines.style: Warm, steady praise delivered without flattery. Slow, clear articulation. Slight pause after his name, settling into genuine observation. The tone of someone who notices careful work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。本気で、絶対、四国、絶対、の伝統工芸、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really appreciate that you took the time to read it so carefully.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, a little shy. Quiet and measured. The words come from sincerity, not habit. Slight breath before 'appreciate' — he means it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地質サンプルの、本気で、絶対、採取、絶対、現場、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you handled the geological sampling methodology — the fieldwork aspect especially — showed real maturity in your thinking.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observational tone. Speaking as someone reflecting on something she noticed. Moderate pace, no rush. The confidence of someone trained to recognize rigorous work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。植物の、本気で、絶対、タンパク質、絶対、構造、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: That's very kind of you to say. I spent a lot of time on the protein structure analysis section — I'm really grateful you noticed that.
lines.style: Earnest, measured response. Slight vulnerability in acknowledging how much effort went in. Warm but not effusive. The relief of being seen for specific work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 深海の、本気で、絶対、探査、絶対、技術、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you addressed deep-sea exploration technology — your engagement with those newer methodologies was sophisticated.
lines.style: Continuous thread of encouragement, but grounded. Specific praise shows she actually read it. Moderate volume, conversational but attentive. The weight of real observation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者の、本気で、絶対、単身、絶対、赴任、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I know the section on researchers undertaking solo field assignments was complex — I'm genuinely grateful you understood what I was attempting there.
lines.style: Quiet confidence mixed with humility. The acknowledgment that she understood the hard parts. Slightly faster than before — the relief of being seen comprehensively.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 測定の、本気で、絶対、誤差、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your treatment of measurement error and margin-of-error analysis showed real statistical literacy. That impressed me.
lines.style: Steady, evaluative tone. She's recognizing a specific intellectual skill. Clear enunciation on technical concepts. No hesitation — she's certain of what she observed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古代の、本気で、絶対、交易、絶対、ルート、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: That's really encouraging to hear. The ancient trade-route reconstruction was something I wanted to get exactly right, and I'm truly grateful you saw the care I put into it.
lines.style: Warm relief in the voice. The satisfaction of being understood on work he cared about. Slightly softer closing — the conversation settling into natural warmth. The gratitude is genuine, not performed.
